NRF2.withdrawal_reason: AUROC 0.539 against held-out measured inactives, sensitivity 0.250. NPASS NRF2 activity is overwhelmingly cell-based reporter readout, which scores pathway activation by any upstream route rather than engagement of NRF2 itself, so there is no single structure-activity relationship for a structural model to learn.
NRF2.withdrawn_reason: added to test natural-product coverage. Cross-validated AUROC 0.719 (scaffold, sd 0.157), so not noise, but AUROC 0.539 against its own held-out measured inactives and sensitivity 0.250 at a threshold that controls the background false-positive rate. Of its labelled NPASS records 0.0 per cent are a direct binding constant (Ki or Kd); 1,019 of 1,029 are Potency, a pooled functional readout that does not define a binding class a ligand fingerprint can separate

NFKB1.withdrawal_reason: AUROC 0.392, below chance, sensitivity 0.095. Same cause: an NF-kappa-B reporter measures inhibition of a signalling cascade with many entry points, not binding to p105.
NFKB1.withdrawn_reason: added to test natural-product coverage. Cross-validated AUROC 0.711 (scaffold, sd 0.151) but AUROC 0.392 against its own held-out measured inactives and sensitivity 0.048 at a usable threshold. Of its labelled NPASS records 0.3 per cent are a direct binding constant; 344 of 362 are Potency. Same cause as NRF2

NR3C1.withdrawal_reason: AUROC 0.479, sensitivity 0.000 at the calibrated threshold: the model identifies none of the withheld actives. 140 compounds spanning steroidal and non-steroidal chemistry is too little, too diverse, to support a model.
